The user wants a yoga retreat in New York with vegetarian meals and spa services. We have no direct tool for searching retreats; we only have a hotel search function which can find hotels but not necessarily yoga retreats or spa services? It accepts location and amenities like Breakfast, Fitness Centre, Free Wi-Fi, Parking. Not exactly what they want.

We could interpret "yoga retreat" as maybe a resort/hotel offering yoga classes and spa services. But our function doesn't support specifying yoga or spa. So we cannot directly use it. Maybe we need to respond explaining limitation. Or ask clarifying question. According to policy, if can't answer, say sorry. There's no mention of providing partial info. Could try to approximate using available data: find hotels in NYC with fitness centre (maybe yoga) and free wifi etc. But vegetarian meals and spa services aren't covered.

Thus best approach: explain inability due to lack of relevant function. Ask follow-up.
